remarks: Fully remodeled one bedroom, one bathroom end-unit condominium on the second floor of Courtland Green in Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood. This 575-square-foot residence was completely updated approximately one year ago and features hardwood floors throughout the living areas, a well-appointed kitchen with oven/range and refrigerator, and abundant natural light from its end-unit position. The unit offers convenient front and rear access. Heat and hot water are included. Amenities include coin operated laundry facilities in the building basement, one reserved parking space, and one visitor parking sticker. The well-maintained community provides landscaped grounds and professional property management. Located near public transportation, shopping, and dining. Pets permitted subject to association rules.
